HMLR_S2_UPDATED_20230509
The estate-plan approval supplement was updated on 9 May 2023.
HMLR_S2_APPLIES_EW
The estate-plan approval service applies to England and Wales.
HMLR_S2_OGL3
The guidance is licensed under the Open Government Licence version 3.0 except where otherwise stated.
HMLR_S2_SPEED_OFFICIAL_COPIES
The service is designed to simplify and speed the supply of official copies while a site is active.
HMLR_S2_SPEED_OFFICIAL_SEARCHES
The service is designed to simplify and speed official searches while a site is active.
HMLR_S2_SPEED_REGISTRATION
The service is designed to simplify and speed subsequent registrations while a site is active.
HMLR_S2_NEGOTIATE_WITHOUT_TITLEPLAN_COPY
Plot-sale negotiations can proceed without an official copy of the developer's title plan.
HMLR_S2_OC1_PLOT_REFERENCE
Form OC1 applications can refer to a plot number on an approved estate plan.
HMLR_S2_NO_PLAN_EACH_SEARCH
An approved estate plan can avoid supplying a separate plan with each relevant application.
HMLR_S2_SPEED_PLOT_NEGOTIATIONS
The service is intended to speed negotiations on individual plot sales.
HMLR_S2_FOLLOW_OR_INDEPENDENT
Estate-plan approval may follow boundary approval or be requested independently.
HMLR_S2_FINAL_LAYOUT_EARLY
The final-layout estate plan should be submitted at the earliest possible stage.
HMLR_S2_APPLICANT_STATUS_REQUIRED
The applicant must show proprietor status, entitlement to registration, or relevant consent.
HMLR_S2_UNCLEAR_STATUS_DECLINED
An unclear applicant status can lead to a request for confirmation and then refusal if unresolved.
HMLR_S2_NO_PLANNING_PERMISSION
Estate-plan approval does not confirm that planning permission exists.
HMLR_S3_UPDATED_20260302
The draft-transfer and lease supplement was updated on 2 March 2026.
HMLR_S3_APPLIES_EW
The draft-transfer and lease approval service applies to England and Wales.
HMLR_S3_FREE_SERVICE
The draft-transfer and lease approval service is free.
HMLR_S3_RESOLVE_DIFFICULTIES
The service is designed to identify and resolve plot-transfer and lease difficulties.
HMLR_S3_EASEMENT_TITLE_DIFFICULTY
Difficulties can concern proof of title to grant easements.
HMLR_S3_CONVEYANCING_DIFFICULTY
Difficulties can concern the wider conveyancing structure of an estate.
HMLR_S3_STANDARD_FORMAT
Approved transfers and leases provide a standard format across a development.
HMLR_S3_FEWER_REQUISITIONS
Applications based on approved deeds are expected to produce fewer requisitions.
HMLR_S3_CONSISTENT_REGISTRATION
Approved deeds support a consistent registration approach.
HMLR_S3_WORKS_WITH_OTHER_APPROVALS
The service is designed to work with estate-boundary and estate-plan approval.
HMLR_S3_SUBMIT_BEFORE_PURCHASERS
Draft transfers or leases should be submitted before they are issued to purchasers.
HMLR_S3_FUTURE_SALES_BASIS
An approved draft can become the basis for future sales on the development.
HMLR_S3_LAND_BANKING_DECLINE
HM Land Registry may refuse approval where it could misleadingly imply likely development.
HMLR_S3_TP1_NORMAL
A transfer of part of a registered title normally uses form TP1.
HMLR_S3_TP2_CHARGEE
A registered chargee transferring under a power of sale uses form TP2.
HMLR_S3_BLANK_FORM_APPROVAL
A self-created electronic transfer form may need blank-form approval before draft approval.
HMLR_S3_DURABLE_A4
Transfer forms are required to be reproduced on durable A4 paper.
HMLR_S3_WORDING_LAYOUT_FONT
Transfer forms must preserve prescribed wording, layout, font and point size.
HMLR_S3_PANEL_DEPTH
Electronic preparation may change panel depth.
HMLR_S3_PANEL_PAGE_BREAK
Electronic preparation may divide a panel at a page break.
HMLR_S3_OMIT_INAPPLICABLE
Electronic preparation may omit inapplicable certificates, statements and corresponding boxes.
HMLR_S3_NO_RENUMBER
Omitted panels do not justify renumbering later panels.
HMLR_S3_SINGULAR_PLURAL
Electronic forms may change singular wording to plural and vice versa.
HMLR_S3_SUBHEADINGS_EDIT
Additional-provisions subheadings may be added, amended or repositioned.
HMLR_S3_SELLER_BUYER
A sale transfer may replace Transferor and Transferee with Seller and Buyer consistently.
HMLR_S3_LEASES_APPROVAL
Draft leases should be submitted for approval as well as draft transfers.
HMLR_S3_PRESCRIBED_CLAUSES
Most qualifying registered-estate leases granted since 19 June 2006 use prescribed clauses.
HMLR_S3_ALL_DEVELOPER_TITLES
Panel 1 must identify all registered titles holding the estate part covered by the draft.
HMLR_S3_OTHER_AFFECTED_TITLES
Panel 2 identifies other titles against which matters in the transfer are to be registered.
HMLR_S3_COVENANT_TITLE_OWNERSHIP
Titles receiving developer covenants must be in the developer's ownership.
HMLR_S3_CONDITIONAL_EASEMENT_BRACKETS
A title affected only by a conditional easement may be enclosed in square brackets.
HMLR_S3_UNREGISTERED_EASEMENT_DEDUCE
Title should be deduced where an easement crosses unregistered or possessory-title land.
HMLR_S3_THIRD_PARTY_EASEMENT_PROOF
The developer must prove title to grant easements over land not in its ownership.
HMLR_S3_PLANS_WHEN_NEEDED
Transfer plans should accompany the draft when needed to explain the intended transaction.
HMLR_S3_APPROVED_PLAN_LIMITS_EXTRA
With an approved estate plan, extra individual plans are needed only for matters it does not show.
HMLR_S3_PROPERTY_OUTLINE
The property-transferred panel should contain an outline description of the property.
HMLR_S3_PLOT_NUMBER_LOCATION
Plot numbers may appear in the property panel or a covering letter.
HMLR_S3_INCLUDE_GARAGE_PARKING
A garage or parking space included in the property should be identified.
HMLR_S3_EASEMENTS_ADDITIONAL_PROVISIONS
Granted and reserved easements belong in the additional-provisions panel.
HMLR_S3_LATEST_APPROVED_PLAN
Transfer plans should copy or extract the latest approved estate plan.
HMLR_S3_TRUE_SCALE_NORTH_COLOUR
A transfer plan should show true scale, north point and relevant colours.
HMLR_S3_INTRICATE_INSET
Intricate boundaries may require a larger-scale or inset plan.
HMLR_S3_CORPOREAL_EXCLUSIONS
Land inside red edging but excluded from the transfer must be stated as a corporeal exclusion.
HMLR_S3_EXCLUSION_PRECISE
A corporeal exclusion must identify its location and precise extent carefully.
HMLR_S3_EXCLUSION_PLAN_REF
A plan reference is generally needed for a corporeal exclusion.
HMLR_S3_POSITIVE_NEGATIVE_EXCLUSION
Vertical exclusions may be described positively or negatively.
HMLR_S3_DRAFT_TRANSFEREE_BLANK
The transferee panel is left blank at draft-approval stage.
